description.value: Sango Sushi is a Japanese restaurant located inside Meadowtown Centre in Pitt Meadows, offering an extensive menu of traditional dishes and house-original creations made with fresh ingredients. The kitchen spans sashimi, nigiri, oshi sushi, teriyaki, tempura, donburi, and noodles, alongside party trays and combo meals. Online ordering is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through on the Lougheed corridor.

address.value: 19800 Lougheed Highway, Unit 350, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 2W1
